title: General bounds on functionals of the lifetime under life table constraints in a joint actuarial-financial framework
summary: In life insurance, life tables provide survival probabilities at integer ages but leave the distribution of deaths within each year unspecified. This incompleteness is particularly relevant for modern insurance products such as variable annuities, whose payoffs depend jointly on lifetime uncertainty and financial market performance. The valuation of such contracts must therefore be carried out in a joint actuarial-financial framework, as their values depend not only on the full information about mortality rates but also on the interaction between mortality risk, asset dynamics and embedded…
